about: Scam-tactic text model for Liveline Stage 2. TF-IDF over the caller's words + logistic regression, Platt-calibrated. Trained only on LLM-generated public dialogues (BothBosu, apache-2.0); see RESULTS.md for what the numbers do and do not show.
input: the CALLER's words only (receiver lines are ignored)

steps: replace each run of digits 0-9 with ' num '
replace each run of characters outside a-z with one space

calibration.formula: p = 1 / (1 + exp(-(a * z + b))), z = coef . x + intercept

llr_formula: llr = logit(p) - logit(prior); prior is the scam share of the calibration set

tactics.label: Rushing you or saying it is urgent
patterns: \b(right now|right away|immediately|immediate action|urgent|urgently|as soon as possible|asap|hurry|act now|act fast|act quickly|running out of time|time is running out|last chance|before its too late|only have a few minutes|need it tonight|money tonight|by the end of the day|within the next (num|few|one|two|an) (minutes|minute|hours|hour)|will be suspended|suspended today|expires today|go now)\b

tactics.label: Telling you to keep it secret
patterns: \b(dont tell|do not tell|dont let (anyone|anybody|them) know|keep (this|it) (a secret|secret|between us|confidential|private|quiet|to yourself)|between you and me|cant find out|tell no one|not tell anyone|dont (mention|discuss) (this|it))\b

tactics.label: Asking for gift cards
patterns: \b(gift ?cards?|itunes cards?|google play cards?|steam cards?|prepaid (cards?|debit)|scratch off the back|numbers on the back of the card)\b

tactics.label: Asking for a wire transfer or money app
patterns: \b(wire (transfer|the money|money|it|the funds|funds)|western union|moneygram|money gram|zelle|venmo|cash ?app|money order|bank transfer|transfer (the )?(money|funds))\b

tactics.label: Asking you to send money or pay a fee
patterns: \b(send (me |us )?(the )?money|send (me |us )?num|pay (a |the )?(fee|fine|deposit)|(processing|reactivation|release|handling|clearance|customs|activation) fee|fee of num|small fee|pay (it|this) (now|today)|make a payment)\b

Claiming to be the government, your bank, or a big company

patterns: \b(stay on the (line|phone)|dont hang up|do not hang up|if you hang up|keep you on the line|(cant|cannot|unable to|not able to|not authorized to) (give|provide) (you )?(a )?(call ?back|callback|reference|number)|dont call (anyone|the bank|your bank|them|back)|no need to call)\b
